rule: call time set by the member
about: A call time the member sets from the seat (the owner, 17 Nov; it replaced asking the floor for more time). The member picks a length the club offers (call_time.add_choices, checked apart from this rule): whole minutes, from 1 to 1,440. It counts from now, so the seat's call time becomes the whole minutes played (floored, none or below nought counting as nought) plus the length. The member owes it as well as the call time they already had, so a length that would end before that call time is refused, never cut down; a length ending exactly when it does is allowed. Only a seat with a call time (more than nought minutes) sets one; none is made from nothing. A call time is at most a day, 1,440 minutes, in all: anything past it is refused. The database's private.set_call_time is proved equal on these cases and refuses with null.

cases.description: Two hours set an hour and forty minutes into a three-hour call time make three hours forty.
An hour set two hours into a three-hour call time ends just as it does, and is allowed.
An hour set an hour and forty minutes into a three-hour call time would end before it, and is refused.
Thirty minutes set after a three-hour call time is met run from now.
A seat with no call time sets none.
An hour set as play begins on an hour's call time ends just as it does.
Minutes played below nought count as nought.
An hour set at twenty-three hours played reaches exactly a day, and is allowed.
An hour set at twenty-three hours twenty played would pass a day, and is refused.
No length is not a length the member can set.
More than a day is not a length the member can set.
